text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. Post-call admin shrank from 30 minutes to under 10.

2. CRM data got better. Next steps and decision-makers were logged on 90% of calls, up from roughly half.

3. Customers noticed. Asking consent upfront built trust. Two prospects even asked for the summary.

4. Coaching changed. Managers stopped guessing and started reviewing real conversations.

5. The tool wasn't magic. Noisy sites and heavy jargon needed manual cleanup.

The biggest win wasn't speed. It was reps being fully present in the room.

Would your team trade note-taking for more face time?

*(Synthetic scenario; figures are illustrative.)*
